caption: The drawing depicts an object that consists of two curved tusk-like pieces, possibly resembling claws, joined at their bases and wrapped with bands of thread or string. The bands are colored in shades of blue, red, white, and appear to form a woven pattern around the meeting point of the two curved elements. A loop of twisted or braided material extends upward from the center, with a horizontal twig or stick inserted through part of this loop. The background of the drawing is a plain, light tan or beige, with the drawing itself presented on a slightly darker square section centered on a larger, lighter paper that has some visible aging and yellowing along the borders. The overall composition is centered, with the object rendered in detailed pencil and colored pencil or watercolor strokes, emphasizing the shapes and textures of the materials depicted.
title: Bone and Beadwork
